text: Iwarebiko fought Nagasunehiko once more, but the battle dragged on, the sky grew dark, and hail began to fall.
spoken: Ee-wah-reh-bee-ko fought Nah-gah-soo-neh-hee-ko once more, but the battle dragged on, the sky grew dark, and hail began to fall.

pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
